requirement: Choose the best data persistence strategy for a high-traffic read-heavy API.

proposals.title: Redis Cache + PostgreSQL
proposals.summary: Use Redis as a caching layer in front of PostgreSQL to handle read load.
proposals.rationale: Proven combination; cache hit rate > 90% for typical read patterns.

proposals.title: Read Replicas
proposals.summary: Scale reads via PostgreSQL read replicas with connection pooling.
proposals.rationale: Simpler ops; no cache invalidation complexity; strong consistency.

criticisms.issue: Cache stampede risk under cold-start conditions.

consensus.summary: Read replicas preferred for simplicity; Redis acceptable if >50K RPS.

finalDecision.reasoning: Lower operational complexity and strong consistency outweigh marginal throughput gains of caching.
